title: feat(mobile): native shell mode — useNativeHost, typed bridge calls, and the Console wired to the mobile shell
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBCu5yU2doirS4gQ2KGHPVk)_

Fixes #29039

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/mobile` is published and gains new exports; the seat writes the TIER_DEFAULT contract review.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Console 现在能识别自己被 ObjectStack 移动端外壳托管（`window.ObjectStackNative`）。`@object-ui/mobile` 新增 `useNativeHost()`、桥的类型与五个不抛错的调用封装；Console 在路由层向外壳发送 `ready()`（每次页面加载一次，首个路由渲染之后）与 `routeChanged(route)`（每次 SPA 导航一次），并接住外壳的 `objectstack-native:navigate` 事件用自己的路由跳转、不再整页重载。
- **为什么改**：移动端 2.0 是包着 Console 的原生外壳，此前 Console 不知道自己被托管：外壳只能等 WebView 的 load 事件才撤加载遮罩，通知点击会整页重载 Console。
- **风险与回滚**：低。没有这个全局对象时，监听器不安装、事件不发送、页面与今天完全一致（有测试与真实浏览器读数两面钉住）。外壳模式下唯一的界面差异是不再注入 PWA 安装 manifest。安全区内边距按席位裁决不加：外壳已经自己给 WebView 加了内边距，再加会重复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/mobile/src/useNativeHost.ts`（延迟检测的复查点、路由接线、导航事件只接受站内路径）；② `ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts`（桥类型、`has()` 能力检测、`NativeCallResult`）；③ `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 的 `NativeShellRouting`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx`，预期 44 个测试全绿（外壳模式 ready 只发一次、导航事件被接住、没有全局时一切照旧）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The ObjectStack mobile shell (objectstack-ai/mobile#144) hosts this Console in a WebView and injects `window.ObjectStackNative`. The bridge contract is the mobile repository's `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md`, section "Native bridge" (read at mobile PR 144 head `443207c`).

**`@object-ui/mobile` (new exports only):**

- `ObjectStackNative` types exactly the contract's members: `version`, `platform`, `appVersion`, `capabilities`, `safeArea`, `has(capability)`, the calls `getPushToken`, `haptic`, `openExternal`, `navigate`, `resetServer` (each a Promise), and the events `ready()` and `routeChanged(route)`. Nothing else is typed. Supporting types: `NativeHapticKind`, `NativePushToken`, `NativeSafeArea`, `NativeHostMethod`, `NativeCallResult`.
- `getNativeHost()` reads the global at call time and returns it, or `null`. `useNativeHost()` is the React form.
- **Lazy detection (the re-check mechanism the brief asks the PR to name).** `useNativeHost()` reads the global at render time (`useSyncExternalStore`), re-reads it once on mount, and, only while no bridge is present, re-checks at `DOMContentLoaded` (if the document is still loading), at the window `load` event, and at 100 ms, 500 ms and 2000 ms after `load`. The timed re-checks exist because the shell guarantees the bridge on Android only by evaluating its bootstrap again after the page has loaded (react-native-webview `injectedJavaScript`), which can land just after `load` fires. A bridge that appears at any of those points re-renders every caller with it. Without the global the hook returns `null` and nothing else happens.
- **Typed wrappers that feature-detect and never throw:** `nativeGetPushToken()`, `nativeHaptic(kind)`, `nativeOpenExternal(url)`, `nativeNavigate(route)`, `nativeResetServer()`. Each checks `has(method)` (capability names equal method names in the contract) and that the method exists, then calls it. Each resolves a `NativeCallResult`: `{ status: 'unavailable' }` (no shell, no capability, no method, or a `has()` that throws), `{ status: 'ok', value }`, or `{ status: 'failed', code, message }` when the shell rejects the call (its error `code`: `unknown_method`, `bad_args`, `failed`). The wrappers carry a `native` prefix so the package entry does not export a bare `navigate`.
- **Events.** `postNativeReady()` posts at most once per page load. `postNativeRouteChanged(route)` does not post a route equal to the one it posted last.
- `useNativeHostRouting({ route, navigate })` is the router wiring: `ready()` after the first commit (or as soon as a late bridge appears), `routeChanged` once per route change, and the navigate-event listener below. Outside the shell it installs nothing.

**Console wiring (`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx`, `main.tsx`):**

- `NativeShellRouting` renders beside the `Routes` element inside `ConsoleShell` (so inside its Suspense boundary) under the `BrowserRouter`. Its first effect therefore runs once the first route has committed, and that is when `ready()` is posted, not at boot. The route it posts is the router location's `pathname + search + hash`, which react-router already gives without the basename; the shell's own `routeFromConsoleUrl` keeps query and fragment too, so the route the shell recovers to is the full one.
- **Maintainer's scope addition** ([comment on the card](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29039#issuecomment-6571060625)): in shell mode the Console listens for the cancelable window event `objectstack-native:navigate`, moves its own router to `detail.route`, and calls `preventDefault()`, so a notification tap does not reload the bundle. Per the seat's ruling, `preventDefault()` is called only after the route is accepted, and only an in-app path is accepted: a string that starts with exactly one `/`, with no backslash and no control character (`//host`, `https:`, `/` + backslash + `host`, a relative path, an empty string or a non-string are left alone, so the shell's `location.assign` fallback runs). The navigation posts `routeChanged` once, through the same route-change effect. Outside shell mode the listener is not installed.
- In shell mode the root element carries `data-os-native-shell="ios|android"`, so a stylesheet can tell shell mode apart. Nothing reads it yet.

**Shell-mode chrome (each element hidden, with the reason):**

- **The PWA install manifest.** In shell mode `main.tsx` removes the static `link rel=manifest` from `index.html` and does not inject the branded blob manifest. The app is installed natively there, so an install manifest has nothing to offer. Read after the boot round-trips; a bridge that lands even later only leaves the manifest in place, which a WebView never acts on.
- Nothing else. The Console registers no service worker and draws no install prompt, so neither fires in the shell. At the shell's phone width the Console already draws its phone layout, which hides the desktop-only chrome (for example the help menu and the desktop search trigger are `hidden md:flex`). No new layout.

**Safe area: a measured departure from the card's Ask 2 ("pads with the `--os-native-safe-*` variables"), ruled by the seat.** The shell already pads its WebView: `components/shell/ConsoleWebView.tsx` at mobile `443207c` wraps the WebView in a View with `paddingTop: insets.top, paddingBottom: insets.bottom`, unconditionally. Padding again in the Console would double the top and bottom insets. So the shell stays the single safe-area owner and the Console adds no padding in shell mode. The insets stay readable (`--os-native-safe-*`, `useNativeHost()?.safeArea`) for a later surface that opts in.

No spec change, no metadata key, no new gate. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/**` is not touched.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx` (40 tests): detection (absent, present, non-object global); late injection after `load` (timed re-check), at `DOMContentLoaded`, at `load`, and the control that stays `null` through every re-check; every wrapper resolves `unavailable` without a bridge, when `has()` says no (and the method is never called), and when the method is missing; `ok` with the value and the forwarded argument; `failed` with the shell's code; a throwing `has()`; `ready` once per page load; `routeChanged` once per route; `useNativeHostRouting` under StrictMode (one `ready`, one post per route), a late bridge receiving `ready` and the current route, the navigate event (in-app route cancelled and routed; six non-app shapes left alone), no listener outside shell mode, listener removed on unmount.
- New `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx` (4 tests), the real `App` under its real `BrowserRouter` with the pages stubbed as in `App.docsPortalLazy.test.tsx`: with a fake bridge installed before render, `ready` arrives once and only after the first route's page is on screen, then `routeChanged('/login')`, and the root carries `data-os-native-shell`; the navigate event moves the router by a history push (no document load) and posts the new route once; a `//host` route is left to the shell; control without the global: nothing posted, nothing marked, the event not cancelled.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed by anchor count and blob hash, file restored byte-identical by hash, under `os-verify-lock`), run on the 44 tests above:

- late-injection watch disabled (`watchForLateInjection` returns at once): 4 red, the three late-injection cases and the late-bridge routing case;
- the `readyPosted` once-guard removed: 2 red;
- `event.preventDefault()` removed from the navigate listener: 2 red (mobile and console);
- the wrappers' `has()` + method check reduced to "bridge present": 11 red.

## Acceptance notes

- **Real-browser reading** (Chromium via Playwright, 390 × 844, the Console's Vite dev server with no backend, so the login route shows "Cannot connect to server"; the bridge installed by an init script before any page script):
  - shell: `__events` = `ready@/login`, `route:/login` (ready posted once, after 19 elements had rendered under the root); root attribute `data-os-native-shell="ios"`; no manifest link; body padding `0px`. Dispatching `objectstack-native:navigate` with `/forgot-password`: `defaultPrevented` true, the page moved to `/forgot-password` with the same boot id (no reload), and `route:/forgot-password` was posted once.
  - browser (no global): no events, no attribute, the branded blob manifest present, the navigate event not cancelled and the page stayed on `/login`.
  - late injection: a bridge installed 50 ms after `load` (the dev server's `load` fired at about 7.4 s) still received `ready` and `route:/login`, and the attribute was set.
- **Finding for the seat (doc mismatch, not filed here):** mobile `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md` "Console-side integration" says the Console should "pad with the safe-area variables", while the shell pads its WebView unconditionally (`ConsoleWebView.tsx` at `443207c`). One of the two has to change before a Console that pads could ship; this PR follows the shell's behaviour.
- **Noted, not changed:** an iPad (or any shell WebView 768 px wide or more) gets the Console's desktop chrome, because the phone layout follows the viewport width. The ruling keeps the phone layout as is and adds no layout; a per-flow change at that width belongs to #29040's children.
- **Noted, not changed:** the contract also lists "register the push token after sign-in and unregister on sign-out". That needs a server device registry and is not in this card's Ask; `nativeGetPushToken()` is ready for it.

## Verification

All at head `1205cf10` (this branch with `origin/main` `5d3667e2` merged in; the merge brought `packages/spec` contract files and a `@object-ui/components` data-table change, nothing under `ui/packages/mobile` or the console files touched here), after rebuilding the console's dependency closure:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/mobile/` plus every `apps/console/src/__tests__/App.*.test.tsx` and the two other console suites that render `App` (`i18nAfterSignIn-12034`, `internalFormShell`), from `ui/`, `--maxWorkers=2`, under `os-verify-lock`: 14 / 14 files, 113 / 113 tests.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4900 tests passed, 2 skipped.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/mobile --filter=@object-ui/console`: 72 / 72 tasks, exit 0. `eslint` on every touched source and test file: 0 problems. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 34 commands, `check-sdui-manifest` among them): 34 / 34 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED).
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` with this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, and `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword` on this body: exit 0.
- Changed lines: about 1,100 (well under 3,000).
